reason: You don't name the payment company, the fee per transaction or when the money lands in my account, and that is the whole deal for me. My card terminal already works, so I won't put an unknown payment partner between my guests and my cash, even for three free months.
objection: A hidden per-transaction fee on top of 59 GEL, and not knowing whether I get paid the next day or wait a week. If the bank fee is higher than my terminal, every table that pays by QR costs me more money.
would_change_my_mind: A written answer naming the licensed payment partner, a per-transaction fee no higher than my current terminal and next-day payout to my Georgian bank account.
